{{ModBox}}
'''Sniper Ammo Mutation''' is a [[Sniper Mods|sniper rifle mod]] that converts any unused Secondary [[Ammo]] into Primary Ammo. The affected weapon will only convert ammo while equipped, and will '''not''' convert any ammo type used by [[holster]]ed secondary weapons until their own ammo is full.

Converted ammo is denoted by a {{Icon|Item|Mutate}} symbol. The final amount of ammo restored is rounded to the nearest integer.

==Acquisition==
*This mod was originally awarded to players who participated in [[Operation Sling-Stone]].
*This mod is now available from [[Survival]], [[Excavation]], and [[Spy]] missions.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Tips==
*Functions well with [[Sentinels|Sentinel]]'s {{M|Vacuum}} or {{Companion|Chesa Kubrow}}'s {{M|Retrieve}}, which automatically collect unused ammo as needed.

==Gallery==
<gallery hideaddbutton="true">
SniperAmmoMutationModOld.png|Pre-{{ver|14.5|nn}} Appearance
</gallery>

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|32.3.3}}
*Fixed being unable to equip Sniper Ammo Mutation on Snipers.

{{ver|32.3}}
*Fixed weapons that formerly used Sniper ammo appearing when using the term “sniper” to search in the Arsenal despite not being categorized as a Sniper weapon. 
**''This would affect a weapon like the Lenz, which now uses Primary Ammo. It can still be found in the Arsenal when searching using the term “Bow”. You can still find your Rubico Prime using the term “Sniper”, so worry not!''

{{ver|32}}
*Sniper Ammo Mutation: Now converts Secondary ammo pickups to 50% of Ammo Pick Up.

{{ver|31.1.7}}
*Fixed the Sniper Ammo Mutation mod not mutating Rifle ammo at the described rate. 
**''For example, at Rank 0 you should receive 1 Sniper ammo per Rifle pickup and it was giving 0.''

{{ver|27.4}}
*Fixed the Sniper Ammo Mutation mod not appearing under the Exilus category in the Mod screen.

{{ver|26}}
*Now an Exilus Weapon mod.
*Mod capacity drain from 9 to 7.

{{ver|15}}
*Players can now upgrade Rifle, Arrow, Shotgun and Sniper Ammo Mutation Mods from max Rank 3 to max Rank 5 with increased effectiveness.

{{ver|9.3}}
*New Ammo Mutator mods: converts unused ammo to select ammo type (Pistol, Shotgun, Rifle, Sniper, Bow).
}}

{{ModBox}} '''Primed Sniper Ammo Mutation''' is a [[:Category:Sniper Mods|sniper rifle mod]] that converts any unused [[ammo]] type into Primary Ammo. The affected weapon will only convert ammo while equipped, and will '''not''' convert any ammo type used by holstered secondary weapons until their own ammo is full. Converted ammo is denoted by a {{Icon|Item|Mutate}} symbol. The final amount of ammo restored is rounded to the nearest integer. ==Stats== {| class="emodtable" |- ! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]] ! Efficiency
(Secondary) ! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]] |- | 0 || 8% || 0 |- | 1 || 16% || 1 |- | 2 || 25% || 2 |- | 3 || 33% || 3 |- | 4 || 42% || 4 |- | 5 || 50% || 5 |- | 6 || 58% || 6 |- | 7 || 67% || 7 |- | 8 || 75% || 8 |- | 9 || 84% || 9 |- | 10 || 92% || 10 |} ==Acquisition== *This mod can be purchased '''unranked''' from Baro Ki'Teer for {{cc|140,000}} and {{dc|400}}. Note however that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and may not have this item available at every time. ==Tips== *Functions well with [[Robotic]] companion's {{M|Vacuum}},{{Companion|Chesa Kubrow}}'s {{M|Retrieve}}, and/or [[Beast]] companion's {{M|Fetch}}, which automatically collect unused ammo as needed. *Mutated ammo always rounds up, resulting in converted ammo even with {{M|Primed Sniper Ammo Mutation}} being completely unranked, saving all capacity cost. This means the effect of unranked {{M|Primed Sniper Ammo Mutation}} is equivalent to fully ranked on weapons with 1 ammo pickup. *{{M|Rifle Scavenger}} applies to mutated ammo pickups ''in addition'' to normal pickups, and counts ''after'' ammo mutation's rounding. For example, on {{Weapon|Rubico Prime}}, it increases all ammo pickups from primary ''and'' secondary pickups to provide 38 and 35 ammo respectively, with max ranked {{M|Primed Sniper Ammo Mutation}}. ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.3.3}} *Fixed being unable to equip Primed Sniper Ammo Mutation on Snipers. {{ver|32.3}} *Fixed weapons that formerly used Sniper ammo appearing when using the term “sniper” to search in the Arsenal despite not being categorized as a Sniper weapon. **''This would affect a weapon like the Lenz, which now uses Primary Ammo. It can still be found in the Arsenal when searching using the term “Bow”. You can still find your Rubico Prime using the term “Sniper”, so worry not!'' {{ver|32}} *Made the following changes to Mods/Arcanes in light of the above ammo changes (stats shown at max rank): **Primed Sniper Ammo Mutation: Now converts Secondary ammo pickups to 92% of Ammo Pick Up. {{ver|31.1.8}} *Introduced. }} {{AmmoNav}} __NOTOC__ [[es:Mutación de munición de francotirador Prime]] [[fr:Mutation de Fusil de Sniper Accrue]] [[ru:Мутатор Прайм: Снайперская Винтовка]] [[uk:Праймована мутація в набої до снайперської гвинтівки]] [[Category:Primed Mods]]
